**Root post of the thread:**

- **Author**: @svector_eth
- **Full text**: "i’m joining @aeonframework as an engineer.

the last few months i’ve been building skopos and a bunch of other stuff, contributing to projects like @elizaOS and @making_cindy, @merit_systems shipping security fixes across other projects ,working on x402, and spending way too much time messing with agents.

somewhere in there aeon stopped being an experiment and became something i ran every day. first on my own projects, then for security research, market research, and coding. then i started contributing. now i’m working on it

what stood out:  @aaronjmars and @0xNurstar are both ridiculously hands-on, the project moves fast, and there’s a very real bias toward actually building things instead of spending weeks talking about what might be possible.

i’ve also met some genuinely great people through all of this, including @z0r0zzz and had a few conversations that turned into opportunities i can’t talk about yet.

one of those eventually became this.

i’ll be building with @aaronjmars and @OxNurstar, and spending a lot more time around builders who are using agents, building agents, and figuring out what they can actually do.

i’ve already been running aeon pretty hard these past couple weeks, and it’s been a genuinely fun team to build with.

very happy to be here.

back to work."
